init.title: Guarded Surfer S1 polling
init.description: Experimental polling using the selected transport: direct local BlueZ when Use saved local adapter is enabled, otherwise HA Bluetooth with active proxies. Local mode never falls back to a proxy. Local polling uses S1_INFO and INFO; HA polling also uses OpInfo and WARN. Enabling polling authorises recurring telemetry writes, subscriptions and disconnects, including after restart, but never cleaning commands. Start/stop are separate actions requiring per-call safety confirmation, or the vacuum entity when its option below is enabled. Keep other clients idle. INFO state labels are app-derived; temperature location, solar and fault meanings remain unverified. Failures back off; unsafe cleanup suspends polling.

data.poll_interval: Successful poll interval in seconds (60 to 3600; under 300 applies only while the signal is at least -90 dBm)
data.confirm_exclusive_access: I authorise recurring queries and will keep other BLE clients idle
data.allow_missing_advertisement: Allow the legacy S1 protocol when advertisement evidence is missing
data.use_local_adapter: Use saved local adapter directly (no proxies or Bleak)
data.confirm_vacuum_controls: Enable vacuum entity start/stop (I confirm the robot is in water, unplugged and nobody is in the pool)

data_description.allow_missing_advertisement: Persistent protocol exception for polling and explicitly requested control actions; not permission to move the robot. ECDH hints, key-exchange services, malformed advertisements and identity or endpoint changes still veto the operation.
data_description.use_local_adapter: Applies to polling, isolated queries and explicit start/stop actions. Requires saved local adapter metadata. Uses direct BlueZ D-Bus with no automatic transport fallback. Disable recurring polling before isolated tests.
data_description.confirm_vacuum_controls: Lets the vacuum entity's start and stop buttons send the same guarded MODE setters as the start_cleaning and stop_cleaning actions, without a per-call confirmation. Keep the app closed. Turn this off whenever the robot is out of the water, on its charger or people are in the pool. The entity's state is available either way.

error.exclusive_access_required: Authorise recurring queries and exclusive device access before enabling polling.
error.local_adapter_required: This entry has no saved local adapter. Keep local mode off; do not infer an adapter from a proxy.

start_cleaning.name: Start S1 cleaning (experimental)
start_cleaning.description: Fresh INFO and WARN checks, one AT+MODE=1 setter and one INFO readback over the selected BLE transport. No retries, toggle, cloud control or transport fallback. Requires explicit physical safety confirmation. APK-derived command; not yet live-validated.

stop_cleaning.name: Stop S1 cleaning (experimental)
stop_cleaning.description: One AT+MODE=0 standby setter and one INFO readback over the selected BLE transport. No retries and no automatic poll. This is not an emergency stop, power-off, return-to-dock or pause/resume command. APK-derived command; not yet live-validated.

query_opinfo_local_bleak.name: Diagnostic OpInfo via HA Bleak on saved local radio
query_opinfo_local_bleak.description: Same-radio comparison only. Disable recurring polling first. Explicitly bypasses the production transport choice for this one action, retaining HA slot accounting and lifecycle. Version-gated to HA's tested Bluetooth dependencies. Requires a fresh saved local route; no proxy, fallback, pairing or retry. Shares cooldown and cleanup suspension; does not update sensors.

poll_now.name: Poll Aiper telemetry now
poll_now.description: Run one guarded S1_INFO, OpInfo, INFO and WARN cycle through the selected transport and update sensors. Polling must already be enabled and authorised. Runs immediately, clearing any offline failure backoff and without waiting for the configured normal interval. Cannot bypass an active probe, suspension, protocol checks or disconnect cleanup. No robot controls.

listen_once.name: Listen for Aiper notifications once
listen_once.description: Connect once and subscribe for at most 60 seconds, including startup notifications. No application reads or writes, queries, controls or retries. Subscription itself may write the CCCD. Stops notifications and disconnects.

protocol_preview.name: Preview one status request offline
protocol_preview.description: Build one fixed OpInfo, S1_INFO, INFO or WARN frame without Bluetooth. INFO and WARN are app-derived from Aiper 3.6.1 build 82; live validation is still required.

query_type.name: Fixed query
query_type.description: Choose OpInfo (Wi-Fi), S1_INFO (temperature/solar), INFO (status/mode/battery) or WARN (raw warning code). One fixed request only; no arbitrary AT command.

checksum_mode.name: OpInfo empty-data checksum policy
checksum_mode.description: Prefer omit_empty_crc for OpInfo; include_empty_crc models an explicit empty object using seed 0x9966. S1_INFO, INFO and WARN always include the nonempty-data CRC regardless of this choice.

write_mode.name: Write transport
write_mode.description: command requires write-without-response; request requires write. Both transports appear in app 3.6.1. The selected flag must exist; no automatic fallback.

query_once.name: Query Aiper status once
query_once.description: Experimental S1 legacy-XOR query. Enables notifications (CCCD write), sends one selected OpInfo, S1_INFO, INFO or WARN request, waits within a fixed deadline, stops notifications and disconnects. Not write-free. No controls, pairing, retries or automatic fallback.

query_type.name: Fixed query
query_type.description: Choose OpInfo (Wi-Fi), S1_INFO (temperature/solar), INFO (status/mode/battery) or WARN (raw warning code). Only the selected request is sent. This local-only diagnostic action does not update the polling sensors.

checksum_mode.name: OpInfo empty-data checksum policy
checksum_mode.description: Prefer omit_empty_crc for OpInfo. S1_INFO, INFO and WARN always include the mandatory nonempty-data CRC regardless of this choice. INFO and WARN hardware compatibility remains unverified.

write_mode.name: Write transport
write_mode.description: command requires write-without-response; request requires write. The app supports both, but this test never switches transport automatically.

confirm_app_closed.name: Other BLE clients idle
confirm_app_closed.description: Confirm the app is closed, other BLE clients idle, and the robot stationary.

confirm_query_write.name: One selected query write authorised
confirm_query_write.description: Authorise exactly the selected OpInfo, S1_INFO, INFO or WARN request, potentially split across multiple ATT writes. No retries or setters.

confirm_notifications.name: Notification subscription authorised
confirm_notifications.description: Authorise StartNotify and StopNotify, including their CCCD writes. This is not a write-free test.

confirm_legacy_probe.name: Guarded probe without advertisement evidence
confirm_legacy_probe.description: Optional, false by default and never saved. Authorise this S1-only legacy experiment if company-zero advertisement data is absent. Requires a resolved, exact legacy GATT endpoint. ECDH hints, key-exchange characteristics and malformed data still veto the query.

read_once.name: Read one raw Aiper sample
read_once.description: Connect once, validate the exact readable Aiper endpoint, read once within five seconds, then disconnect. No retries, writes, notifications, pairing or robot commands. Raw bytes are not decoded telemetry.

confirm_app_closed.name: Other BLE clients idle
confirm_app_closed.description: Confirm the app is closed, all other BLE clients are idle and the robot is stationary.

confirm_read_only.name: One raw read authorised
confirm_read_only.description: Authorise one read of the known Aiper characteristic. Keep the unparsed response private.

preflight.name: Check discovery prerequisites
preflight.description: Validate existing local adapter/device metadata. Does not initiate a BLE connection.

discover.name: Discover GATT services once
discover.description: Connect once, list GATT metadata, then disconnect. No characteristic-value reads/writes, pairing or notification subscription. Keep the robot stationary and other BLE clients idle.

confirm_app_closed.name: App closed and test authorised
confirm_app_closed.description: Confirm the Aiper app is closed, other BLE clients are idle, and this single connection is authorised.
